subject: general
question: Which of the following states is the cradle of the folk music traditions of Saikuti Zai?
solution:
The correct answer is __**MIzoram.**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **The people of Mizoram are traditionally known as the 'Singing Tribe'.**
 
• The regional folk songs of Mizoram are the richest heritage of Mizos.
 
• **Saikuti, a poetess from Mizoram, composed songs in praise of warriors, brave hunters, great warriors and young men who aspire to be hunters.**
 
• She also praised the warriors for their achievements against their enemies.
 
• **Mizoram is the cradle of the folk music traditions of Saikuti Zai.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Mizoram's folk music consists of swaras (singing) accompanied by traditional drums, gongs and other native percussion instruments.**
 
• Flute-playing also has a long history which has now come to an end.
 
• Drums are made from a hollow tree trunk, with a membrane made of cow hide, and clocks made of brass are similar to those found in Myanmar.
 
• Most of the Mizo musical instruments used at the time of festivals and dances are different types of khuang and striking instruments like dar, bengbung, seki, talkhuang.
 
• Mizo folk songs are named after the person. Most of them are named after the original composer of music as well as verse melodies.
